facts.name: Bonnie J. Helms
facts.assignment: Profile states Family, Dependency and Juvenile Courts at Key West and Marathon, plus Family Treatment and Juvenile Drug Court. Chief term stated July2021–July1,2025; retained as historical.

contact.contact_note: Roster and profile header name Brandy Wilson; embedded instructions heading says Raquel Galvan. Section A publishes305-852-7155 for persons excused from email service, distinct from header office number. Differences retained, not resolved.

scheduling.summary: File motion before requesting hearing by JA email; supply case/motion/time and coordination information. Coordinate parties, confirm setting, then file/serve notice. Email JA and file/serve cancellation notice to cancel.

communications.summary: Email JA with case number, name and relevant matter in subject; copy all parties/counsel. Procedural/scheduling communications only; no substantive ex parte contact.

proposed_orders.summary: Submit Word orders through Portal proposed-order function, shared with other parties, and cover letter identifying agreement or disagreement; ordinarily within two days after hearing unless instructed otherwise.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email JA PDF/A courtesy materials. Section B says five business days before hearing; section E says five days. Both timing statements retained.

remote_appearance.summary: Profile describes hybrid appearances subject to instructions; request remote appearance five days before hearing and join ten minutes early. Zoom997-8001-9533, no passcode.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Basic scheduling, communication, submission and appearance only; no detailed family/juvenile/diversion procedure analysis.

review_scope.collected: Official original HTML, collapsed/expanded text and DOM with timestamps; reused roster.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contact and assignment statements, basic communications/scheduling, proposed-order submission, courtesy delivery and remote appearance instructions.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Emergency-motion substance, exhibit identification, trial readiness, settlement deadlines, detailed conferral assertions, family/juvenile forms and diversion programs.

conflicts.summary: Profile contact header and roster identify Brandy Wilson; embedded divisional heading identifies Raquel Galvan. Communications section uses Brandy Wilson email. Neither conflicting name deleted from evidence.
